mathematical_findings.finding: J55=-SD5 and every scaled cross entry use the reciprocal local Jacobian. Original logQ one-SD and physical bounds are transformed into reciprocal bounds. Fourteen scalar minimizers and the jointly constrained reciprocal-capacity/SOC polygon are treated together. The six halfplanes cover the box and both cumulative-charge extrema.

Outward absolute row sums majorize the computed full symmetric scaled metric in real arithmetic. Original metric must pass unmodified Cholesky. The diagonal construction is optimizer geometry, not posterior precision, and is not a global upper bound after nonlinear coordinate mapping.

Strict original division-order path support, original-coordinate one-SD bounds, resolved original-gradient slope and full/diagonal tangent model decreases are rechecked. Nonfinite/invalid metric errors remain negative; finite rounding/no-direction states remain unresolved. The candidate alone is never an accepted estimator update or a stationary point claim.

Quadratic-first features are closed under d_old=d_new+s. Upper R*T preserves the already represented polynomial in real arithmetic. Constant-first/linear-second writes need no second factor. Read-only prospective validation precedes mutation; unexpected mutation failure requires unavailability.

Current raw block is appended once only after accepted-point translation/transport. Old polynomial is never relabeled relinearized evidence. Original prior is included once, in its unchanged base measure; no density Jacobian is introduced for direction coordinates.

Second-order boundary recentering and current-block derivative engine remain explicitly unimplemented. Their approximation error persists after old samples are discarded; current-block conditional evaluation is not full historical replay.
